text_block_list.text:
—The Arima Kinen has finally arrived.
Among the elite worthy of this Golden Era...
There were also challengers from the new generation present.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wanna try jumping straight up in the air?
Like, inside the starting gate. It'd probably be hilarious.

—Gold Ship.
This year's Classic Double Crown Umamusume.
She stormed into Nakayama with wild momentum.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool! Do not bother me before a race!
Besides, what kind of idiot jumps at the gate?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, no? I'm kinda not feeling it, so
I feel like it'd be fun if you did that for me though.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, where's everybody's fighting spirit?
Guess I've got no choice~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Time for Golshi-chan to tear this place up!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race is packed with competitors from every generation,
and not a single one will be an easy opponent."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I can take 1st place
among today's lineup...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"As an honorable Umamusume,
I can bring my career to a magnificent conclusion."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You will be able to welcome
a truly glorious "end."

Unable to stay silent any longer after hearing
her speak with such total lack of attachment—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Is this... the race schedule
for after the Arima Kinen?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Did you create this, Trainer?
choice_data_list: This might be a bit sloppy, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, the flaws are quite noticeable.
May I ask why you made it?
choice_data_list: Because I want you to keep on running!
Because I want you to keep running!

text_block_list.text:
If... If the most important plan in her life
has even the slightest space for 'running'...!
choice_data_list: I want to watch you run!
I want to keep watching you run!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
This planner contains my schedule
for the next ten years.
(Rip... riiiip!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...A stronger sense of guilt wells up inside me than I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I did say 'the last' earlier,
—but it hasn't actually been decided yet.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I was able to show my parents a proud figure.
I no longer have a reason to run."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However—that desire to 'keep running'
remains strong... so very strong.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So I thought to myself:
"What would the person I admire do?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"My parents would surely follow the planned path.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I believed you would. You would... call that intuition
of still wanting to run 'the right choice.'"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's think about our future schedule
once we get back."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"This Arima Kinen isn't the end.
It marks our brand new beginning—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I shall bring back a victory
worthy of you!
